mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CO_NOTICE SET VIEW_CNT = VIEW_CNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId}
mapper.select: SELECT n.SCOPE_CD, n.TARGET_CD, MAX(COALESCE(p.PRODUCT_NM, b.BIZ_NM, n.TARGET_CD)) AS TARGET_NM, COUNT(*) AS CNT, MIN(COALESCE(b.SORT_ORD, 0)) AS SORT_KEY FROM TB_CO_NOTICE n LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON n.SCOPE_CD = 'PRODUCT' AND p.PRODUCT_CD = n.TARGET_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CO_NOTICE_BIZ b ON n.SCOPE_CD = 'BIZ' AND b.BIZ_CD = n.TARGET_CD WHERE AND n.SCOPE_CD IN ('PRODUCT', 'BIZ') GROUP BY n.SCOPE_CD, n.TARGET_CD ORDER BY n.SCOPE_CD, SORT_KEY, TARGET_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_NOTICE (SCOPE_CD, TARGET_CD, TYPE_CD, TITLE, CONTENT, START_AT, END_AT, FIX_YN, STRIP_YN, POPUP_YN, USE_YN, VIEW_CNT, REG_AT, REG_BY, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{scopeCd}, #{targetCd}, #{typeCd}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{fixYn}, #{stripYn}, #{popupYn}, #{useYn}, 0, #{updAt}, #{updBy}, #{updAt}, #{updBy})
mapper.select: SELECT t.TYPE_CD, t.TYPE_NM, t.BADGE_COLOR, t.SORT_ORD, t.USE_YN, t.UPD_AT, t.UPD_BY, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_CO_NOTICE n WHERE n.TYPE_CD = t.TYPE_CD) AS NOTICE_CNT FROM TB_CO_NOTICE_TYPE t ORDER BY t.SORT_ORD, t.TYPE_CD
SELECT TYPE_CD, TYPE_NM, BADGE_COLOR, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY FROM TB_CO_NOTICE_TYPE WHERE TYPE_CD = #{typeCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_NOTICE_TYPE (TYPE_CD, TYPE_NM, BADGE_COLOR, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{typeCd}, #{typeNm}, #{badgeColor}, #{sortOrd}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE TYPE_NM = VALUES(TYPE_NM), BADGE_COLOR = VALUES(BADGE_COLOR), SORT_ORD = VALUES(SORT_ORD), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_AT = VALUES(UPD_AT), UPD_BY = VALUES(UPD_BY)
mapper.select: SELECT BIZ_CD, BIZ_NM, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY FROM TB_CO_NOTICE_BIZ ORDER BY SORT_ORD, BIZ_CD
SELECT BIZ_CD, BIZ_NM, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY FROM TB_CO_NOTICE_BIZ WHERE BIZ_CD = #{bizCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CO_NOTICE_BIZ (BIZ_CD, BIZ_NM, SORT_ORD, USE_YN, UPD_AT, UPD_BY) VALUES (#{bizCd}, #{bizNm}, #{sortOrd}, #{useYn}, #{updAt}, #{updBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE BIZ_NM = VALUES(BIZ_NM), SORT_ORD = VALUES(SORT_ORD), USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN), UPD_AT = VALUES(UPD_AT), UPD_BY = VALUES(UPD_BY)
mapper.select: SELECT 'PRODUCT' AS SCOPE_CD, PRODUCT_CD AS TARGET_CD, PRODUCT_NM AS TARGET_NM FROM TB_PRODUCT ORDER BY PRODUCT_KIND, PRODUCT_NM
